data.condition_notes: The IC appears to be in excellent physical condition. All markings are clearly visible and legible, with no signs of wear, damage, corrosion, or re-marking. The pins are straight and clean.
data.reasoning: The part number 'STM32F107RCT7' and manufacturer logo (ST) are clearly visible. The package is identified as an LQFP-64 based on its square shape and a careful count of 16 pins per side, totaling 64 pins. 'CHN' explicitly states the country of origin. The 'T' in 'RCT7' indicates an industrial temperature grade (-40°C to +105°C), and 'RC' specifies the package (64-pin) and flash memory size (256KB). The 'ARM 7' marking denotes the processor core architecture (Cortex-M3). The date code '912' is interpreted as Year 2019, Week 12, which is consistent with the product's typical lifecycle. 'G0243' and 'GQ' are identified as lot/internal manufacturing codes. The 'e3' symbol indicates environmental compliance (RoHS compliant, Pb-free), and '1A' is an internal production identifier. The physical condition is excellent with all markings clearly etched.
